integrity.claim_type: proved theorem with finite computational cross-check
integrity.source_role_note: The 2026 paper is the initiating recent source; the 2009 paper is supporting background.

scientific_limitations: The gap-bound isometry assumes 2 <= k < n < kU; the saturated boundary can be disconnected.
The visibility metric corollary concerns triples on simple unweighted cycles, not arbitrary hosts.
Isometry means some ambient shortest path stays admissible, not every such path.
The computational comparison covers finite n <= 17 and does not replace the infinite proof.
Independent validation and exhaustive historical-priority assessment have not been performed.
title: Gap-slack isometry and exact token-sliding distances for mutually visible triples on cycles
